notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
Just in time for the holidays we have a new patch ready for you guys!

We changed the way scores work to make it more fun and the leaderboards more competitive. Sadly this also means we had to reset all leaderboards :(
But now we're finally able to organise CONTESTS for you guys! In the contests we will give away t-shirts, plushies and other Beatbuddy related items  on a regular basis to the best Beatbuddy: On Tour players. We will announce upcoming contests over our Beatbuddy 
[url=facebook.com/Beatbuddy]Facebook[/url] and [url=twitter.com/beatbuddygame]Twitter[/url] page in early 2016, so be sure to like it and stay up to date ;) 

Furthermore we also fixed the achievements and some other small bugs.

Enjoy the patch and we wish you a super cool christmas and a happy new year!
Countless hugs,
your THREAKS
